why: The answer applies each jump statement correctly to this loop's values (even i are skipped, the loop ends at i = 5), but gives two separate effects rather than one combined account of how break and continue relate.

concepts.quote: break stops the loop completely at 5

concepts.quote: continue jumps to the next i for the even numbers
concepts.why: It correctly applies continue to the even values: the rest of the pass is skipped and the loop moves on to the next i.
